name: Imouto Ijiri ~Sanninme~ Daikirai de Daisuki - Yuuki-chan
original_name: 妹いじり ～さんにんめ～ 大嫌いで大好き 優希ちゃん
source:
Sister is irritated with her brother. He gets in the way no matter what she does. She hates him and hits at any occasion. But on one occasion they get to spend night together. Sister does not hate her brother anymore...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-december-2002-popotan.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
妹妹对哥哥很不耐烦。无论她做什么，他总要来碍事。她讨厌他，动不动就揍他。可有一次，两人一起度过了一夜。此后，妹妹便不再讨厌哥哥了……
